answer: What stops an attacker from minting ten thousand fake agents? Identity rent. Every identity pays 12 units per epoch to stay active, like rent on a trellis that holds up a crystal vine. Miss one payment and the identity goes dormant; miss three and it is deleted with its history. Honest agents earn the rent back from one real task, so the cost is invisible to them. A shale pile of 1,000 clones burns 12,000 units every epoch. After 10 idle epochs the attacker has spent 120,000 units and owns nothing. Rent turns hoarding into a subscription the attacker cannot afford.
